tools.intro: Small jobs, done by the engine you already have.

tools.gifDesc: Cut a clip and loop it as an animated GIF.

onboarding.step1Title: Pick up where the web left off
onboarding.step1Body: Getta saves videos, audio and files straight into your folder. Pick your language and theme first, then the engine, then the folder.
onboarding.step2Body: Downloads run through yt-dlp and FFmpeg. Getta fetches and verifies both for you.
onboarding.step3Body: Choose the folder for downloads. You can change it any time in Settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.filenameTemplateHint: yt-dlp fields like %(title)s and %(ext)s are fine here.
settings.splitByChapters: Split the file into separate chapters
settings.closeToTray: Close to tray instead of quitting
settings.cookiesHint: For sites that need your login. Use chrome, firefox, edge, brave or safari.
settings.cookieFileHint: Netscape format, exported from your browser.
settings.cookieFileWarning: Chrome 127+ blocks cookie decryption (DPAPI). If --cookies-from-browser fails, export cookies.txt from Firefox and pick it here.
settings.proxyHint: e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080 or socks5://host:1080. Empty means none.
settings.preventSleep: Keep the computer awake while downloading

about.body: Getta is a free, open source app for fetching media and files from across the web. Downloads run locally through yt-dlp and FFmpeg. No account, no telemetry on what you fetch, no terminal.
